_schema.note: Session ids the records pipeline should SKIP (ADR-0097): test runs, stray start/stop-glitch folders, and mistyped-animal bundles that are not real experiment sessions. Non-destructive: the bundles stay on disk, so removing an id here brings a session back. Read by build_session_registry (this repo) and build_session_training_log (resources repo, via the OS_CODE_T_MAZE resolver). See docs/notes/Bugs.md #260810_RecordsIntegrity.
